ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (light grey/white) ventral surface with approximately 25-30% low-intensity (black) coverage concentrated on the trailing edges and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous light-tone zones occupy the central areas of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a thick, irregular band along the right lobe trailing edge and a central triangular wedge originating from the peduncle. Distinct dark circular pixel clusters are localized on the upper-right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 45 degrees and high vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations on the right lobe trailing edge (peak variations of 10-25 pixels). Left lobe trailing edge exhibits moderate-frequency serrations with lower pixel-amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a symmetrical upward and outward sweep. Leading edges are smooth and convex; trailing edges are generally linear but interrupted by significant micro-topographical variations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, high-contrast white pixel clusters (1-5 pixels) are visible within the black pigmentation zones of the trailing edge on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A cluster of distinct dark circular spots on the right fluke lobe; prominent irregular indentations and jagged notches along the trailing edge profile of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A deep, roughly rectangular-shaped indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe approximately midway between the notch and the fluke tip.
